thought.text: I'm starting three cargo builds in parallel that will take some time to compile.

reasoning_content: Since CI uses the latest stable tool, I'll proceed with the latest versions. Kicking off three cargo installs in parallel in the background (these take a while to build). I'll run each with nohup and output logs to a file.

action.command: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"; cd /tmp; (nohup cargo install wasm-pack --locked > /tmp/wasm-pack-install.log 2>&1 &); (nohup cargo install bacon --locked > /tmp/bacon-install.log 2>&1 &); (nohup cargo install sqlx-cli --no-default-features --features rustls,postgres --locked > /tmp/sqlx-cli-install.log 2>&1 &); sleep 3; ps aux | grep -E "cargo install|cargo-rustc" | grep -v grep | head -6

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "export PATH=\"$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH\"; cd /tmp; (nohup cargo install wasm-pack --locked > /tmp/wasm-pack-install.log 2>&1 &); (nohup cargo install bacon --locked > /tmp/bacon-install.log 2>&1 &); (nohup cargo install sqlx-cli --no-default-features --features rustls,postgres --locked > /tmp/sqlx-cli-install.log 2>&1 &); sleep 3; ps aux | grep -E \"cargo install|cargo-rustc\" | grep -v grep | head -6", "summary": "Start cargo installs of wasm-pack, bacon, sqlx-cli in background", "security_risk": "HIGH"}
